description: Tracked-only scoped Claude ACP adapter with per-prompt native auth-state observation and explicit terminal failure metadata. ACP end_turn ends transport processing and does not mean work/artifact success or acceptance. The v3 identifier is a packaging revision, not ACP protocol 3 support. No credentials, profile data, instructions, work data, runtime state or canonical metadata is inherited. Native Node and Claude remain external SHA-pinned runtimes. Assembly does not install, register or activate a bot, deliver a Bot Chat notice, or complete the workshop tool chain.
